name: deepseekv41_sparse_mla_extra_extra_idx_inv_rope_pos_strided_pages_n_heads32_page_size32_n_indices128_extra_page_size128_n_extra_indices512
description: sglang's sparse MLA of a DeepSeek-V4.1 layer on gfx950 (aiter_sparse_decode_fwd): each head of each token attends the slots its indices name (-1: none) in the layer's KV pool and in the optional extra one, with scores q . row * sm_scale; sinks join the normalisation only; the output is the softmax-weighted sum of the rows, 0 for a token that reads no row. With rope_freqs, the last 64 values of every head are then rotated back in pairs (a, b) by the pair's (c, s) at the token's position: (a c + b s, b c - a s).

n_tokens.description: Tokens in this call, one query each.

page_size.description: Slots per page of the KV pool.

n_indices.description: Indices per token into the KV pool.

n_extra_pages.description: Pages of the extra KV pool.

extra_page_size.description: Slots per page of the extra KV pool.

n_extra_indices.description: Indices per token into the extra KV pool.

q.description: Each token's query per head, the RoPE part last.

kv_cache.description: The layer's KV pool: DeepSeek-V4's packed fp8 slots.

indices.description: Slots of the KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

sinks.description: Per-head logit added to the normalisation only.

extra_kv_cache.description: The extra KV pool, the same packed slots.

extra_indices.description: Slots of the extra KV pool each token reads; negative: skipped.

rope_freqs.description: The RoPE table: a (c, s) per pair of each position.

positions.description: Each token's row of the RoPE table.

output.description: Each head's attended values, the RoPE part rotated back with rope_freqs.
